snippet.title: Trapped Dead // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/46540/Trapped_Dead

You and up to three friends fight to survive the Zombie outbreak in this game inspired by early '80s horror films!

👥 Players: Single Player, Co-op
🛠️ Developer:  Crenetic
📚 Publisher:  Crenetic
📅 Release Date: Jul 15, 2011
🎯 Genre: Action, Strategy
